signature_scope: Knowledge reference and named-context signatures carry complete normalized native results, with native projection ownership checked before named normalization. Existing memory_sql/source_sync signatures cover documented read subsets. source_write has first/last semantic checkpoints and durable receipt checks, not full semantic hashes of every timed write. Retrieval first-negative signature covers content, not order. Zero-budget/import cases do not all have independent complete-envelope signatures.
cpu_clock: Serial process_time_ns and calling-thread thread_time_ns overlap. Concurrent process CPU is batch-only; worker thread CPU and coordinator thread CPU are separate, never additive with process CPU.
aggregation: Median of each round p50/p95/p99; retain every round and negative result; batch and serial units stay separate
first_negative_sync_limit: One first-negative sample per side per round; no tail/population estimate
write_control_limit: Write paths unchanged is a source fact, not proof of latency non-regression; independent fixture observations remain sensitive to WAL/OS/background/ordering noise

cpu_clock_protocol.thread: thread_time_ns: calling thread only; excludes HTTP/ASGI workers

worker_clock_protocol.batch_thread_cpu: thread_time_ns: coordinator only, excludes executing workers
worker_clock_protocol.batch_wall: includes submission, barrier wait, native work and joining all slots
